metadata.description: Production-grade Claude Code plugins by Omer Yehuda: Army (a chief of staff, 18 specialist units and 8 standalone drills), Studio (an AI film crew for explainers, cartoon shorts and realistic films), Video Creator (one command per visual style) and Skill Installer (every skill scanned, pinned and locked).

plugins.name: army
plugins.description: A chief of staff that commands 18 specialist units as subagents, plus 8 drills you can run on their own: trial (decisions), admit (bugs), taste (reviews), countdown (releases), exam (skill evals), recall (records), edition (release notes) and lanes (parallel sessions). 110+ on-demand playbooks, model profiles (eco, lean, full), a measured token ledger with a per-mission budget, safety gates and local memory.

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: A film crew of AI agents in three formats: kinetic-typography explainers with AI narration and a trend desk, animated cartoon shorts from true stories with Hebrew RTL captions (formerly toon-shorts), and realistic short films from stills you generate (formerly Premiere). A director pass sets camera positions and shot-to-shot flow in every format. One install, one hash-locked venv, one voice model.

plugins.name: skill-installer
plugins.description: Install Claude skills from GitHub the safe way: a customs scan gates every install (CLEARED installs, SECONDARY INSPECTION asks, DENIED never installs), files come from one pinned commit, skills.lock.json records hashes, and audit rescans what you have. Includes the Customs inspector.

plugins.name: video-creator
plugins.description: One command per visual style (/video-creator:voxel, /video-creator:3d-realistic, /video-creator:anime and 11 more), plus mix two styles, restyle a story and save your own. Style locked into every prompt by code, a free animatic before you spend credits, a frame checker, and an ffmpeg cut with per-style fps, grade, texture, transitions, music bed and captions for Shorts, TikTok, Reels, YouTube or feed.
